story_text:
## Background Story
For those who love travel and nature, an outdoor-focused vacation is a wonderful experience—especially the joys of outdoor cooking and off-grid living. However, the hassle of gear and preparation, the anxiety of running out of power, and the fire risks posed to the wilderness often deter people. We decided to change this by integrating energy storage and cooking capabilities into a single device. Thus, the first product in the TET life series—the Portable Power Cooking Station—was born.
## T.E.T Portable Power Cooking Station
## No Hassles. Just Outdoors.
Camping's greatest joy is a hot meal in the open air — yet between the heavy gear, the battery that dies at dusk, and the fire ban that leaves no flame for dinner, too many trips end before they truly begin.
## What Can TET Do for You?
## We Make Travel Easy
## Don't worry,Travel Light
No need to pack too much outdoor gear—it’s as easy and carefree as a weekend getaway.
## One Device, Two Kinds of Freedom.
Dual-zone electric cooking and dependable LiFePO4 power for camp, overland and life beyond the grid.
## User-Friendly, Portable Design
Ergonomic Three-Fold Pole& Easy to move and lock Portable casters，Simply drag it to where you want to go
## We make off-grid cooking simpler and more efficient
## Two cooking zones: to meet different cooking needs
A highly efficient and reliable heat source that lets you showcase your culinary skills outdoors
## Precise Temperature Control
Strong winds may interfere with the fire and affect the outdoor cooking experience, but since our heat source does not come from an open flame, we can achieve precise temperature control.
## No Flame.No Smoke.
Induction technology lets you cook anywhere, even in firerestricted zones. No gas, no soot, no worries.
## We Make Charging More Convenient
## Meeting Your Electricity Needs
This device is equipped with Type-C PD 3.0 and USB QC 3.0 charging ports, ensuring a continuous power supply for your devices no matter where you are. The DC port also allows you to connect a car power adapter to power other outdoor devices.
## Dual-source charging
It supports both mains and solar charging, so you don't need to worry even if there is no power outlet nearby.
## One device, multiple scenarios
## Exceptional Performance, Peace of Mind
## Big Capacity, Built Right In
## Ensuring Safety
## More Colors. More Family Time.
## As featured in Homecrux · October 2026
Homecrux coverage of the TET Portable Power Cooking Station, a battery-powered dual-zone cooking station for camping and RV use.
## Product Specifications
## Our Commitment
## About Us
## Energy, Stored for Life
TET builds energy storage into everyday products — cooking, lighting, tools — re-inventing each one with electricity to solve real problems and make life more convenient and comfortable.
## 30 Years of Industrial Battery Craft
TET is an energy storage brand rooted in thirty years of manufacturing industrial-grade batteries. More than 23 motorcycle manufacturers choose TET batteries as their OEM battery — every TET product carries that heritage: LiFePO4 chemistry, smart BMS, ISO-certified manufacturing.
## For more information, follow us
## Our Email Address
risks: Risks & Challenges Bringing a new product to market always involves challenges. However, we have taken significant steps to prepare for production and reduce potential risks before launching this Kickstarter campaign. Experienced Manufacturing Team Our manufacturing team has over 30 years of experience in industrial-grade battery production, including batteries and energy storage products for automobiles, motorcycles, and other transportation applications. With established production facilities, experienced engineers, and professional quality control, we have the experience and infrastructure needed to support large-scale production. To ensure reliability and safety, our products undergo professional third-party testing, and the relevant testing and certification reports have been issued. Key production materials and essential components have also been prepared for mass production. Potential Challenges Some factors remain beyond our complete control, including supply chain delays, component availability, additional regulatory requirements, international shipping, and customs clearance. If unexpected challenges arise, they may affect production or delivery timelines. We believe that honest and transparent communication is essential. Our Commitment to Backers Throughout production and delivery, we will keep our backers informed about important progress and any unexpected challenges. We are committed to communicating openly, addressing issues proactively, and doing everything we can to deliver a high-quality product to every backer as planned.

updates.title: Packaging is done: honeycomb cardboard, built to recycle
updates.text:
Our packaging is done. This is the first carton built for the TET Portable
Power Cooking Station, and here's how it's made.
The box isn't just a box. Its walls are built on a honeycomb core — a layer of
hexagonal paper cells, the same cell structure used in honeycomb panels, where
strength comes without weight. That core is what takes the load when a carton
gets stacked, dropped or stepped on.
The carton itself is made from recyclable paper — walls, honeycomb core, every
panel of it. That's a deliberate choice, and it's the same principle behind
everything we make at TET: material that can be…
